No shiny frame is the same drawing, so on 2026-10-29 each pixel was checked against the official shiny colour at the same place in the closest frame pairs of PokéAPI's and Pokémon Showdown's rips of the Black and White animation: 0 pixels differ (RGB555), and each normal colour maps to one shiny colour

shiny of the Game Freak sprite: the Generation 9 Resource Pack's shiny still KYUREM_3.png at 1/2 scale, which is frame 0 of Game Freak's Black 2 and White 2 animation (the pack's Credits.txt credits its Gen 1-5 sprites to veekun), with Game Freak's fire from frames 76 and 120 grafted on as in the normal sprite (selection add-kyurem-white-overdrive, confirmed by Michael on 2026-10-12). On 2026-10-29 each pixel was checked against the official shiny colour at the same place in PokéAPI's and Pokémon Showdown's rips: 0 pixels differ (RGB555). Its one split colour, the yellow that is the fire core and the eye, splits the same way in Game Freak's palette
